brief:
Israeli occupation forces expelled Palestinian farmers from their land in the village of Jamain, south of Nablus, the Ma'an news agency reported. The expulsions targeted agricultural areas as farmers prepared for seasonal work.

Details of the scope and scale of the expulsions were not immediately available. The incident marks the latest in a series of actions affecting Palestinian agricultural access in the West Bank.
title: Israeli forces expel farmers from land in Jamain south of Nablus
